newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Congo's Kabila to meet opposition chief - aide.
newsitem.headline: Congo's Kabila to meet opposition chief - aide.

text.p: Self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila will meet populist opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi on Thursday for talks on forming a government for the new Democratic Republic of Congo, an opposition official said.

"They're going to meet around 2 p.m. (1300 GMT)," Tshisekedi's cabinet director Dieudonne Nyengela told Reuters at the politician's home. "We're waiting for the security services to come here to take Mr Tshisekedi to Kabila's residence for the face-to-face."

Kabila's top aide met Tshisekedi on Wednesday to discuss moves to form a government in the former Zaire to replace that of veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko, toppled by Kabila's AFDL alliance guerrillas last weekend.
Kabila arrived in Kinshasa on Tuesday, the day he had promised to unveil his new team. He missed his own deadline but a senior aide said an announcement could come later on Thursday.
"We are finalising things. By the end of the day we may have an announcement," the secretary-general of Kabila's office, Moise Myarugabo, told Reuters.
